shots.prompt: The composition, subjects, teal-slate palette, pale-blue bioluminescence, dusk light and one molten-gold accent remain exactly as in the start frame. Only the named action moves. DD shifts weight forward and half-raises both crystal crossbows; AZ lifts Oathkeeper two centimeters off the blackrock; spore-mist thickens one layer. Audio: soft armor creak and quiet water lap under low wind and distant spore hiss.
